cases.prompt: I am debugging login auth. Starting from authenticate and JwtService.verify, I need every hop that validates the bearer token / JWT claims and loads the user from the repository into the model — credential checking and user resolution only. Do not pull billing, mail, or analytics side effects into the heatmap.

Same auth stack, but I only care about the credential-checking path (bearer extract → JWT verify → decode → user resolve). Explicitly exclude ok-logging and login analytics tracking even if authenticate calls them.

I am implementing checkout. From checkout begin and cart validate, collect the full begin path the agent must read to understand how a checkout starts: validation, pricing quote, inventory reserve, and payment charge wiring. Include the structural callees on that path.

Focus a pricing-only slice of checkout: from begin and quote, collect quoting and catalog unit pricing needed to price the cart. Skip inventory reservation and payment charge even if begin eventually reaches them.
Payment slice of checkout: from begin and invoices.charge, follow how checkout charges the card (http pay) and records audit. Skip pure inventory-only branches that are not on the charge path.
Pricing deep dive: from quote and catalog.unit_price, collect catalog unit pricing and anything quote needs to compute a price. Keep pay/checkout orchestration out unless required for quote itself.
Background jobs: from worker.run and jobs.runner execute path, trace dequeue → execute → digest delivery so I can see how a job is processed end-to-end.
Job run until digest is produced, without telemetry noise: follow run/execute into digest generation; drop unrelated log/track-only leaves that are not required for digest.
Webhook ingress: from ingest and verify_sig, collect signature verification, parse, and routing for an inbound webhook so I can harden verification.
Search path: from search.query and rank, collect tokenize → rank/score → fetch_docs for answering a search request.
